subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about pointing retargeting at the completed purchase for your Singapore catalogue. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO to the purchase itself and read each one back through a server-to-server postback with order ID and basket value before it counts, so the volume you pay for is validated buyers, with bot and duplicate traffic screened out first. Illustratively that has held around a 4.1x retargeting ROAS on the abandoned-cart segment. Worth pulling the abandoned-cart view for {Brand}?
illustrative_flags: 4.1x retargeting ROAS on the abandoned-cart segment (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN ecommerce retargeting SG: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof (purchase optimization + S2S postback with order ID/basket value + bot/dupe screening); one illustrative figure (4.1x retargeting ROAS); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native business English, no transliteration; no sign-off; no X-not-Y.
